title: Labs
description: Source-preserving laboratory observations. Clinical grading and treatment decisions are out of scope. v2.1 adds per-value column-pairing provenance (pairing_method required; candidate_value / pairing_confidence / pairing_note). A value bound only by linear position (scripts/pair_lab_columns.py) is a CANDIDATE: `value` stays null and the number lives in `candidate_value`, which never feeds trends, charts or the case summary. Legacy schema_version "2" archives are read leniently by validate_structured_outputs.py (WARN, not FAIL).

normalized_analyte.description: Validated additive normalization; never replaces analyte.

value.description: Value exactly as represented after faithful extraction.

raw_value.description: Source string including inequality/qualifier where present. Verbatim cell text only — pairing/refusal notes go to pairing_note.

reference_range.description: Range printed on this exact report/result; never reused across dates.

report_flag.description: Flag printed by the reporting laboratory; not model-generated.

critical_flag.description: Critical-value notation printed by the laboratory, if any.

candidate_value.description: Number bound to this analyte by a NON-confirming method only: linear_position (counted-column position on linear OCR text) or llm_row_read (a model reading the table row by row with no deterministic coordinates). With any other pairing_method candidate_value is null. A candidate is NOT a confirmed value: never copy it into value, trends, charts or the case summary.

pairing_method.description: How the result cell was bound to this analyte. bbox = coordinate-OCR row binding computed by scripts/pair_lab_columns.py --tsv (never by the model); table_parser / native_table = parsed table structure of a born-digital source; linear_position = counted-column position pairing on linear OCR text (candidate only); llm_row_read = a model read the row with no deterministic coordinates or structure (candidate only); single_value = the report carries one result; none = pairing refused (item and value counts differ) — value and candidate_value stay null.

pairing_note.description: Column counts / refusal reason / OCR glyph notes, e.g. 项目 8 / 数值 8 / 单位 7 / 参考范围 7.
